create_invitations: create invitations for collaborators to join a Prolific workspace with a specified role
create_invitations_as_admin: create workspace admin invitations for a list of collaborator email addresses via the Prolific API
create_invitations_as_collaborator: create workspace collaborator invitations for emails using the Invitations class and WorkspaceRole constant
review_invitations_class: review the Invitations class that extends BaseAPIResource to send POST requests to the Prolific invitations endpoint
summarize_invitations_create: summarize the Invitations.create method that sends workspace_id, collaborator emails, and role to the Prolific API
